minor.issue: Per-IP rate limit uses request.client.host but k8s ingress can route via multiple proxy nodes giving different IPs per connection — burst limit can be partially defeated. In a 5-shot curl burst we observed 429 only after the 3rd hit. Acceptable for marketing demo but flag for hardening if abuse becomes a concern.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/studio.py line 58: ip = request.client.host fallback won't dedup correctly behind a multi-node k8s ingress. Recommend: ip = (request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') or request.client.host or 'anon').split(',')[0].strip() — first proxy hop. Same single-process in-memory dict still won't survive --reload but that's only a dev concern.

/app/backend/routers/studio.py line 44: _DEMO_LAST_CALL is an unbounded dict — every unique IP forever. For a low-traffic marketing route this is fine; flag if ever promoted to a heavily-hit surface (TTL eviction or LRU cap of e.g. 10k entries).

Landing.jsx is already 343 lines with FAKE_SIGNALS + FirstRunDemo inlined. ThreePillars + EnterpriseFeature + HeroSection now externalised — good split. FirstRunDemo could move to /components/marketing/FirstRunDemo.jsx for parity.

Note that if a user types AND clicks sample within 800ms, two API calls will fire (debounce timer not cleared on sample click). Minor; not breaking.
